prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 1: identify what makes an accounting answer authoritative
prior_coverage.summary: Establish reporting basis and distinguish authoritative requirements from a cash-management convention.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 2: apply direct guidance before choosing an analogy
prior_coverage.summary: Apply directly applicable guidance before testing an analogy or claiming a policy election.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 3: test the accounting feature that makes an analogy relevant
prior_coverage.summary: Test the contractual and economic features that support or defeat an accounting analogy.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 4: use explanatory material without promoting it into a requirement
prior_coverage.summary: Use Concepts and explanatory literature without presenting them as codified requirements.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 5: separate an announced amendment from the rule for this reporting period
prior_coverage.summary: Separate issuance, effective dates, early adoption and transition using a fictional training rule.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 6: evaluate an error in context before calling it immaterial
prior_coverage.summary: Evaluate aggregate errors, benchmark choice and qualitative consequences with reproducible figures.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 105 foundational lesson 7: identify the SEC reporting layer without treating every SEC document alike
prior_coverage.summary: Distinguish SEC reporting obligations, document authority and the limits of peer-filing comparisons.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 1: connect the statements without treating them as interchangeable
prior_coverage.summary: Connect profit, cash, equity and financial position using a fully reconciled fictional first-year example.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 2: compare like amounts across reporting periods
prior_coverage.summary: Separate a supported expense reclassification from an economic change and preserve like-for-like comparisons.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 3: test whether a disposal qualifies as discontinued operations
prior_coverage.summary: Distinguish component, disposal-status and major strategic-shift questions without an invented percentage threshold.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 4: separate discontinued results without changing total income
prior_coverage.summary: Reconcile continuing, discontinued and total income using explicitly assumed classification and tax conclusions.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 5: distinguish financial distress from imminent liquidation
prior_coverage.summary: Distinguish financial distress from an imminent liquidation and identify unresolved approval or execution conditions.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 6: set the going-concern evaluation period before testing the forecast
prior_coverage.summary: Set an issuance-based look-forward period and consider obligations and information within the applicable assessment.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 7: test both implementation and effect of management plans
prior_coverage.summary: Test timely implementation and net mitigating effects of dependent cash-management plans.

prior_coverage.title: ASC 205 presentation lesson 8: match the going-concern disclosure to the supported outcome
prior_coverage.summary: Distinguish the disclosure consequences of alleviated and remaining substantial doubt without offering a compliance-ready note.

tasks.focused_question: Can an operating asset remain current when its ordinary cash-conversion cycle exceeds one year?
tasks.summary: Use a substantiated normal operating cycle rather than a universal twelve-month cutoff or a convenient collection delay.

tasks.focused_question: Can an asset be current even when it will provide a service rather than turn back into cash?
tasks.concept: Current portion of a recognized prepaid operating benefit
tasks.summary: Separate the short-term and later consumption of an already-recognized prepayment without expensing the unconsumed benefit.

tasks.focused_question: Does recording a collection allowance automatically move a trade receivable out of current assets?
tasks.concept: Maturity classification versus the carrying amount of a receivable
tasks.summary: Keep the current/noncurrent conclusion distinct from an assumed supported allowance, and reconcile the resulting net carrying amount.

tasks.focused_question: How should a multi-year borrowing be split when some principal comes due within the next year?
tasks.concept: Current maturities of an otherwise long-term borrowing
tasks.summary: Use the principal repayment schedule to distinguish current and later portions while keeping future interest and classification exceptions separate.

tasks.focused_question: When does a long-term restriction keep a cash balance out of current resources?
tasks.concept: Classify a separately restricted long-term cash fund
tasks.scope_boundary: Do not generalize every restriction or apply SEC presentation rules to all entities.
tasks.summary: Use the purpose and release conditions of a separately restricted cash fund rather than the bank-account label to assess current classification.

tasks.focused_question: Why can an ordinary operating payable be current even when its settlement is part of a longer normal operating cycle?
tasks.concept: Classify an ordinary operating trade payable
tasks.scope_boundary: Exclude covenant, refinancing, demand-debt and unusual financing cases.
tasks.summary: Evaluate an ordinary operating trade payable within a supported normal cycle without turning the payment deadline into an optional date.

tasks.focused_question: How can a current obligation be settled by providing a service rather than paying cash?
tasks.concept: Identify the current portion of an assumed recognized customer advance
tasks.scope_boundary: Stipulate revenue recognition and exclude refunds and complex contract modifications.
tasks.summary: Separate the current and later portions of an assumed recognized customer advance by the promised performance schedule, rather than treating every liability as a cash refund.

tasks.focused_question: Does positive working capital show enough spendable cash for a particular payment date?
tasks.concept: Distinguish the current-assets subtotal from immediately available cash
tasks.scope_boundary: Do not repeat the ASC205 going-concern test or give a solvency conclusion.
tasks.summary: Use a dated synthetic cash schedule to show that a positive current-assets-minus-current-liabilities subtotal does not ensure cash is available at each due date.

tasks.focused_question: Does having a receivable and a payable with the same counterparty alone permit balance-sheet offsetting?
tasks.concept: Separate common-counterparty identity from permission to offset
tasks.scope_boundary: Do not write a complete offsetting checklist in this single lesson.
tasks.before_drafting: Confirm the narrow scope, overlap and evidential basis; adjust or defer rather than invent an authoritative condition.

tasks.focused_question: Why does a bookkeeping net balance fail to establish a legally enforceable right of setoff?
tasks.concept: Separate legal enforceability from ledger presentation
tasks.scope_boundary: Avoid legal opinions; require verified applicable conditions before explaining a rule.
tasks.before_drafting: Confirm the narrow scope, overlap and evidential basis; adjust or defer rather than invent an authoritative condition.

tasks.focused_question: Why is an enforceable right distinct from the intended settlement method?
tasks.scope_boundary: Do not generalize instrument-specific exceptions or imply intent alone is sufficient.
tasks.before_drafting: Confirm the narrow scope, overlap and evidential basis; adjust or defer rather than invent an authoritative condition.

tasks.focused_question: What changes when an already-authorized offset is displayed net rather than gross?
tasks.concept: Reconcile the display effect of a stipulated permitted offset
tasks.scope_boundary: Stipulate that offsetting is permitted; do not infer permission from an unchanged equity total.
tasks.before_drafting: Confirm the narrow scope, overlap and evidential basis; adjust or defer rather than invent an authoritative condition.
